text: ヒント　いわで　ながれを　せきとめられるかも…

structure.jp: ながれを　せきとめられるかも…
structure.en: you might be able to block the current...

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb can mean 'be able to'. せきとめられる = 'can block it off'.

patterns.name: 〜かもしれない
patterns.explanation: かも is short for かもしれない and means 'maybe'. せきとめられるかも = 'you might be able to block it'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing shows what you use to do something. いわで = 'with boulders'.
